sources.title: The difference between The Witcher 3 and Witcher 4 will be 'comparable' to that of GTA 5 and GTA 6, CD Projekt boss says: 'I mean, it's been 11 years'
sources.text: CD Projekt Red reported its Q3 earnings today, but all anyone wanted to talk about was GTA 6. CD Projekt made its Q3 2026 financial report today, and there's not a whole lot to see: The Witcher 3 remaster was a big hit, work on Cyberpunk 2 and The Witcher 4 is ticking along, and everyone really liked Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2. Perhaps understandably, a number of questions in the subsequent investors call put the focus on Grand Theft Auto 6 . While CD Projekt joint CEO Michał Nowakowski didn't go too deep on the topic, he did say that the upcoming Witcher 4 will be comparable to GTA 6 in at least one way. "Obviously, this is a call about us, not about Rockstar, but I do understand the connection here," Nowakowski said when asked if The Witcher 4 will represent a technological leap over its predecessor comparable to GTA 6. "Having said that, of course, I'm not going to make a deep dive and a full-blown review of GTA 5 versus GTA 6. But of course, we did look at the game. We did see the differences. "Do we believe there's going to be a comparable leap between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4? I think so, yes. I mean, it's been 11 years. We are working on The Witcher 4 to make it significantly better looking and improved in terms of pretty much every possible facet of the game. So yes, you should expect us to make a much bigger jump between Witcher 3 and Witcher 4." Well, sure. As Nowakowski said, The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt was released 11 years ago, and it'll be two more years before The Witcher 4 comes out—assuming it's not delayed, which would make it a rarity among CD Projekt games. It will also be the same number of years between Witcher 3 and 4 as spanned GTA 5 and 6. In the world of technology, 13 years is a long time. Hell, just the upgrade from the original Witcher 3 to the remastered version that dropped earlier this year is notable: At the same time, Nowakowski said that while the GTA 6 launch was tremendously successful, CD Projekt Red doesn't intend to merely mimic Rockstar's approach when The Witcher 4 is ready to go: "Our games are different and the require a certain different approach, and we just do certain things differently than they do." Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. He also said that while the release of GTA 6 has had an impact on Witcher 3 and Cyberpunk 2077 sales on consoles, he doesn't expect it to have a "material impact" on the company's Q4 finances for one obvious reason. "You do have to remember that a lot of our players are also PC-based," Nowakowski said. "GTA has not launched on PC. We have not seen any impact whatsoever on the PC sales on engagement." And, he added, "on the PS5 and Xbox, it's not like our sales came to zero." Nowakowsi also said that GTA 6 hasn't changed CD Projekt's ambitions for The Witcher 4 and Cyberpunk 2: If anything, it's "an inspiration in many ways for our developers." And he's not concerned about its success pushing up development budgets, because CD Projekt's games "are not budget-driven developments." "I'm not saying that we don't care about the budgets. We do, and I'm pretty sure [Rockstar] did as well," Nowakowski said. "But you cannot make games like that having in mind, 'This is the fixed number of money I want to spend, and that's it. Otherwise, we're gone.' "They are ambition-driven developments and money is important. The budgets are not indefinite. That's not what we're saying. But the philosophy is kind of like I said. And honestly, that philosophy has not changed for us because of GTA 6's release. It has just always been like that." Nowakowski's positive take on GTA 6 isn't too far off that of Cyberpunk 2 creative director Igor Sarzynski, who said yesterday that he's suffering from " GTA 6-induced-open-world-game-dev-depression ," although he quickly clarified that CD Projekt is "doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor." (And that he wasn't being serious about cancelling Cyberpunk 2.) seriously though i think we're doing something of our own, with a different unique flavor. GTA is impressive in a way all great art is, it expands what is possible, a captivating vision flawlessly executed The Witcher 4 is currently slated for launch sometime in 2028, while Cyberpunk 2 isn't expected out before 2030. From there he graduated to the glory days of Sierra Online adventures and Microprose sims, ran a local BBS, learned how to build PCs, and developed a longstanding love of RPGs, immersive sims, and shooters. sources.title: The Witcher 4 terá salto geracional parecido com o de GTA 5 para GTA 6, confirma CD Projekt RED
sources.text: GTA 6 é bom? Confira a review do aguardado Grand Theft Auto VI GTA 6 já está disponível e certamente deve servir de inspiração para diversos estúdios da indústria nos próximos anos. A CD Projekt RED, por exemplo, acredita que a evolução de The Witcher 3 para The Witcher 4 será comparável ao salto técnico e visual de GTA 5 e a sequência da Rockstar. A informação foi compartilhada durante uma reunião com investidores, na qual os executivos da desenvolvedora polonesa responderam a perguntas sobre o novo RPG e também comentaram o lançamento de GTA 6 — considerado o maior da história do entretenimento . Apesar de reconhecer que os dois projetos possuem propostas diferentes, a empresa acredita que o intervalo de 11 anos entre os jogos da franquia The Witcher permitirá uma evolução significativa. A promessa é de melhorias em praticamente todos os aspectos da experiência. Durante a reunião, um investidor questionou como The Witcher 4 se compara a GTA 6 , considerando o sucesso comercial e técnico do lançamento da Rockstar. O co-CEO da CD Projekt RED, Michal Nowakowski, ponderou que não seria adequado fazer uma comparação completa entre os dois projetos — mas reconheceu que a equipe acompanha os avanços da concorrência. “Antes de mais nada, esta ligação é sobre nós, não sobre a Rockstar, mas entendo a conexão”, afirmou o executivo. Ele também explicou que a desenvolvedora analisou as diferenças entre GTA 5 e GTA 6 para entender a dimensão da evolução apresentada pela sequência. Nowakowski acredita que uma transformação semelhante poderá ser observada entre The Witcher 3 e o próximo capítulo da franquia. Segundo ele, os 11 anos que separam os dois jogos representam uma grande janela de oportunidade para aprimorar consideravelmente os gráficos, a jogabilidade e outros elementos da experiência. “Acreditamos que haverá um salto comparável entre The Witcher 3 e The Witcher 4 . Já se passaram 11 anos. Estamos trabalhando em The Witcher 4 para torná-lo significativamente mais bonito e aprimorado em praticamente todos os aspectos do jogo”, declarou. O executivo completou: “Então, sim, vocês podem esperar um salto muito maior entre The Witcher 3 e The Witcher 4 ”. Durante a mesma reunião, os investidores também buscaram entender se o lançamento de GTA 6 poderia provocar mudanças no cronograma de desenvolvimento do próximo The Witcher — como ocorreu com outros estúdios alguns meses antes da estreia . A CD Projekt RED, porém, afirmou que não alterou seus planos por causa do jogo da Rockstar. A empresa também reiterou que The Witcher 4 continua previsto para 2028. Até o momento, não existe uma data específica de lançamento, mas a janela já havia sido mencionada anteriormente em atualizações sobre o desenvolvimento do RPG. Outro detalhe envolvendo o projeto é uma parceria de marketing com a Sony. O acordo indica que o PlayStation deverá ter participação importante na divulgação do jogo quando a campanha promocional começar, embora a empresa ainda não tenha apresentado detalhes sobre essa colaboração. Até agora, o público teve acesso apenas a cenas cinematográficas e a uma demonstração técnica que apresentou o jogo rodando no PlayStation 5 . O material mostrou recursos gráficos e desempenho do projeto no console, mas ainda não revelou uma demonstração completa da jogabilidade. A CD Projekt RED também já compartilhou alguns detalhes sobre o tamanho da equipe responsável pelo novo RPG. Em uma atualização publicada antes da Gamescom 2026, Michal Nowakowski confirmou que mais de 500 desenvolvedores estão trabalhando no projeto. “Nossa equipe aqui na sede da CD Projekt RED está trabalhando arduamente em uma saga totalmente nova, com Ciri no comando”, afirmou o executivo. A protagonista será o centro da próxima aventura, que dará início a uma nova fase da franquia. Na ocasião, Nowakowski também descreveu o jogo como o projeto mais ambicioso da história do estúdio. Segundo ele, The Witcher 4 terá um mundo aberto vasto, combates intensos e uma narrativa profunda, com lançamento previsto para 2028. E você, já está ansioso para The Witcher 4 ? sources.title: Lords of the Fallen 2 delayed to April 2027, release date coming next month
sources.text: The sequel was only announced last summer It's happening. We have some more movement on Lords of the Fallen 2 from CI Games. No, there still isn't a release date, but we know when we're getting one. The action RPG sequel is now due to arrive slightly later than previously announced, but still in the first half of 2027, and we'll be hearing more quite soon. Marek Tyminski, the CEO of CI Games, reveals the details himself. "Lords of the Fallen 2: April 2027," he writes on Twitter . "Exact date in December." What Tyminski's post doesn't specify this that this is actually another delay. The game was originally due in the back half of this year, before moving to the first quarter of 2027 . While it's slightly annoying to only get an announcement for the announcement, at least we know we don't have long to wait to find out when exactly Lords of the Fallen 2 is coming out. Knowing the release month is very helpful too. I could be wrong here, of course, but that seems to all but guarantee the game's presence at The Game Awards. Trailers and reveals are always a big part of the show, and I'm not sure where else we might see the follow-up otherwise, unless CI Games is planning some sort of livestream of its own we're not yet aware of. Regardless of the delay, this is all pretty quick turnaround for the release, since Lords of the Fallen 2 was only announced during the Opening Night Live of Gamescom 2025. Maybe I'm just jaded from increasingly elongated announcement schedules for blockbuster games, but getting the release window only a year and a half after the formal reveal is pretty tight by today's standards. I mean, we just waited years to find out what the full title of The Elder Scrolls 6 is. We'll see what CI Games has to offer come December, which, at time of writing, is just six days away. Maybe Mariah Carey will be involved in some way. I doubt it, but imagine. I bet she loves a bit of Lords of the Fallen, honestly. sources.title: Sony Confirms PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December 2026
sources.text: Sony has confirmed the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December, which will be available to download from Tuesday, December 1 to Monday January 4. In a PlayStation Blog post , Sony said Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, and Amnesia: The Bunker are December’s three titles. Will you be able to tear yourself away from GTA 6 to give either of these games a shot? Or perhaps you're after a palate cleanser after pumping 100 hours into Rockstar's epic? IGN's Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 review returned an 8/10. We said: "Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 proves yet again the series’ over-the-top skateboarding formula is totally timeless, even if some of the changes to THPS4 miss the mark and the soundtrack has been fumbled." Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, meanwhile, got a 7.5 back in 2017 . "Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2 is an ambitious , if rough-edged experience, with deceptively deep RPG and brawling elements," we said at the time. And our Amnesia: The Bunker review returned an 8. We said: "Amnesia: The Bunker is a smaller, more self-contained episode in the groundbreaking horror franchise that shows Frictional still has some chilling new tricks up their sleeves." It’s worth noting that PlayStation Plus members have until Monday, November 30 to add the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for November (Dead Island 2, Tomb Raider IV – VI Remastered, Monster Train 2) to their library. sources.title: The 25 Best PS5 Games in 2026
sources.text: What are the best games on PlayStation 5 ? Hard as it is to believe, the PS5 is — by Sony's own admission — already well past the halfway point of its life-cycle. (It's even time to start thinking about PS6 .) It's fair to say that PS5 hasn't been deluged with classics, and the rate of must-play new releases is slower than it has been on previous PlayStations. But it does now have the ultimate killer app: Grand Theft Auto 6 . That aside, the PS5's library has grown to the extent that there's a lot to sort through, and new and old PS5 owners will be wondering what to play. So here’s our living list of the best video games we’ve played on the platform — influenced by the personal tastes of the Polygon team — to be updated as more games come out. Our latest update to this list on Nov. 25 added Grand Theft Auto 6 . The Polygon staff plays a lot of video games, and everything in this list comes personally recommended by at least one of us. We determined what should be on our list of the best PlayStation 5 games by looking at the quality of each title, but also with an eye for breadth and variety — so you should find something on the list you’ll enjoy, no matter what genres of game you like, how much time you have, or what vibe you are after. A full six years into the PS5's life, here it is: the game that finally makes sense of this console generation, and makes it all worthwhile. GTA 6 is the best-reviewed game of all time, and you don't have to spend long with it to understand why. It's a deeply engrossing world of astonishing detail, reactivity, and scope, rendered in all the seedy, dayglo glamor that can be mustered by the most expensive video game production of all time. It's a familiarly scattershot satire of modern life in America. But — and it's a huge but — it's also a game of real sensitivity and heart. The central couple of Jason and Lucia are straight-up adorable and Rockstar shows, for the first time in the series' history, a moving willingness to see the best in people. Well... some people. —OW Read Giovanni Colantonio's full review of Grand Theft Auto 6 . If you're craving a return to the days of Wipeout, when a PlayStation racing game was as likely to involve antigravity sci-fi craft rocketing around at hundreds of miles per hour as realistic cars, then Galactic Racer is the game for you. It also happens to be one of the most innovative racing games in a long time, a much-needed shake-up for a stale genre. It introduces a roguelite structure and build-crafting into both single-player and even multiplayer modes, while keeping it all totally coherent with a very Star Wars fantasy of racing dangerous, rickety hot rods. As a treat, there's a healthy dose of Burnout in there, too. —Oli Welsh Read Oli Welsh's full review of Star Wars: Galactic Racer . Here's another classic PlayStation flavor resurrected in an unexpectedly glorious way. As the latest in Bandai Namco's long-running dogfighting air combat series, Ace Combat 8 sounds like a niche known quantity. Try it, however, and you'll be pleasantly surprised again and again: by the sophistication of the controls, the variety of the level design, the meaty length of the campaign, the amazing fidelity of the visuals, and the depth and seriousness of its operatic wartime storyline. —OW Read Giovanni Colantonio 's full review of Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve . The PS5 generation has been a bit short on really great tactics games, but that's all changed with this superb squad strategy game from Bit Reactor, set during Star Wars' Clone Wars era. Many on the team worked on Firaxis' XCOM reboot games, and you can sure tell — this is fine-honed game design full of precision, personality, puzzle-like ingenuity, and just the right amount of unpredictability. Zero Company also makes brilliant use of its setting, compellingly painting a grunt's-eye-view of the collapse of the Republic, and assembling a squad of characters you'll really care about. Especially when you lose them forever in the default permadeath setting. —OW Read Elijah Gonzalez's full review of Star Wars Zero Company . It's been a long time since there was an official James Bond game, and a much longer time — almost 30 years, in fact — since there was a really great one. 007 First Light might not attain the legendary status of GoldenEye 007 , but it's a very slick and entertaining blockbuster action game that's a lot smarter than it needed to be. The key is an inspired choice of developer in IO Interactive, of Hitman fame. IO's love of open-ended "social stealth" gameplay sneaks its way in between the set-pieces and rounds out a thoroughly satisfying adventure with a unique perspective on a young Bond. — OW Read Ford James' full review of 007 First Light . It's defiantly not for everyone, but when the planets align, Bungie's take on the extraction shooter genre can be a totally electrifying multiplayer experience. Its asymmetric PvPvE gameplay can be hard to get your head around, never mind brutally unforgiving, but for intensity and drama it can hardly be matched, and Bungie is to be commended for including interesting solo as well as group roles. On top of this, you have intriguingly deep sci-fi world-building, Bungie's world-class gamefeel — 25 years on from Halo , there are still no more satisfying guns to shoot in gaming — and absolutely stunning art direction, realising one a compellingly chilling future. — OW Read Corey Plante's impressions of Marathon . You can accuse this sequel to Supergiant Games' smash hit roguelike action game of overcomplicating the pure brilliance of the first Hades , and we did. But really this is quibbling with something that's very close to perfection. The combat is still crisp and thrilling, the randomized boons are still exquisitely balanced, the see-saw between progression and setback on each run is still perfectly judged, and the languid, sexy bickering of Supergiant's take on the pantheon of Greek mythology is still gloriously characterful

sources.title: How to Play Grand Theft Auto VI in the Cloud and with Remote Play
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto VI supports XBOX Cloud Gaming , making it available to play even without a current-gen console. With XBOX Cloud Gaming, you can play by streaming it straight from the cloud to your XBOX One, or XBOX Series X|S if you’d like to save some hard drive space. Select Game Pass plans include a monthly allotment of up to 15 play hours, and you can buy more cloud playtime if you need it, giving you the opportunity to experience one of the biggest games of the year on the consoles you already own. The game uses XBOX Series S graphics settings when cloud-streamed with XBOX Cloud Gaming. You can also access Remote Play to enjoy Grand Theft Auto VI wherever you want to play , allowing you to stream gameplay directly from your XBOX Series X|S console to devices you already own, like your mobile phone, laptops, PCs, or even a handheld gaming PC like the XBOX ROG Ally. Here’s how to get these features up and running (a copy of Grand Theft Auto VI from the XBOX Store is required): To start your Cloud gaming session in Grand Theft Auto VI , you can use the controllers that are connected to your console following these steps: When possible, connecting a wired Ethernet cable is the best option for gaming quality. FYI, even wireless networks with high bandwidth can occasionally have a dip in audio and video quality. Remote Play allows you to stream gameplay from your XBOX Series X|S to devices you already own, like mobile devices, PCs, and handheld gaming PCs. Here’s how to enable it: Once you’ve completed those steps above, you can move forward with Remote Play on one of your devices: Whether you’re streaming from the Cloud to save space or picking up right where you left off on your handheld PC, XBOX Cloud Gaming and Remote Play give you more ways to play Grand Theft Auto VI on the devices you already own. For more info, visit XBOX Cloud Gaming and Grand Theft Auto VI on the XBOX Store.

sources.text: Rockstar's GTA 6 has barely been out for a few days, but UK retailer ShopTo is already offering some surprisingly generous discounts on the new release across PS5 and Xbox Series X|S — letting you pay as little as £53.85 for the game. sources.title: The Normal Person’s Guide To Understanding Grand Theft Auto 6
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 is everywhere you look. Every news channel is talking about it. Celebrities and musicians are playing GTA 6 or posting about its release. It’s apparently the biggest game ever and has sold nearly 40 million copies already . But if you aren’t a big gamer or not a video game fan at all, you might have questions. I have answers. Perhaps someone sent you this link because you kept asking them GTA 6 questions. Maybe you did a Google search, made it past the AI results and found this blog explaining what GTA 6 is to people who don’t buy or play games. Whatever the case, welcome. I’m going to walk you through what is almost certainly the biggest video game launch of the decade , why people are going so wild, and what the game actually is and isn’t. It is an open-world game that mixes together a lot of video game genres, like driving, shooting, and exploration. As with most open-world games, you can run around freely or do story missions. It’s up to the player. You control two characters, Jason and Lucia, who are criminals on the run in fictional versions of Florida and Miami named Leonida and Vice City, respectively. More or less, yeah. The developer, Rockstar Games, has been working on this game since at least 2015 or so. Turns out creating a photorealistic recreation of a chunk of Florida that players can explore and do whatever they want in takes time! No. You can buy it on either PS5 or Xbox for $80. The $100 version comes with a bunch of extra outfits , hairstyles, and other items players can wear or buy in-game using cash they collect from crimes, but it’s definitely not required. It took me about 90 hours to reach the end of the main story. I’ve since played over 150 hours, and I’m still finding new stuff, hearing new songs, and seeing new random events. Yeah, it’s big. Well, a lot of people have been waiting for 13 years to play GTA 6 . The last new GTA game, GTA V , was released back in 2013. So anticipation for this game has been building for a long time. And, surprisingly, GTA 6 lived up to the hype. There are a few reasons for the glowing critical reception. The game’s narrative is really good, featuring two extremely well-written characters that develop a meaningful relationship over the course of its five chapters. Another big reason for the high review scores is just how expansive and reactive the world is. Characters in the game will comment on your clothes, respond to your actions, and remember things you did hours and hours ago. It’s also a lot of fun to play, with challenging but rewarding driving, combat, and police encounters. And it looks incredible, with some of the best graphics ever seen in a console game. Some critics are calling it the best game of the year. And many players are calling it one of the best games ever. GTA: Vice City on the PS2 was much, much smaller and less advanced (though in some ways it was pretty advanced for the time) and was set in the 1980s. While Vice City is a major location in GTA 6 , this is an unconnected and different version of the city from that seen in the original 2002 PS2 game. So many things! Players can steal cars, drive boats, get into fist fights, shoot at the cops, go fishing, play mini-golf, hit the gun range, pet dogs, scuba dive, fly planes, explore the swamps, hunt deer, join in street races, visit the beach, get drunk, buy clothes, play fake video games inside the game, take a shower, eat food, work out, blow up cars, or just chill in a bar. You can also just play through the game’s main story, which is all about Jason and Lucia trying to make some money as criminals to build a life for themselves and their son. Yes, Jason and Lucia have a child, a fact which was omitted from any pre-release marketing but is revealed in the first 20 minutes of the game. During the events of the game, he is living with his aunt while Lucia and Jason do whatever they can to make a good life for him and get him back. She is an attractive but disturbing character players meet very early in the game who may or may not be a serial killer or creepy stalker. Despite this, many people online still want to have sex with her. Some players also think Jason should hook up with Mandy and ditch Lucia. These people are wrong. No. While you can do that stuff, GTA 6 doesn’t force you to be a good boyfriend. You can be a real jerk to Lucia, and she can be a real asshole to Jason. Also, the chores players are talking about only make up a few minutes of the opening hours of GTA 6. The rest of the game has none of that stuff in it. Like the chores mentioned already, these elements are optional. If you constantly skip working out, your characters will eventually become less ripped and might even develop small bellies and thicker thighs. But you can still play all the missions and shoot cops. What? You can totally shoot random people, cops, and more. That’s not accurate. You can shoot, punch, tackle, burn, run over, drown, choke, and slap women. Uhh, you can steal cars. Some cars, like very fancy cars, have special security measures, so you can’t steal them as easily, but you can walk up to any person driving a car at a stoplight, rip them out and take their ride. Okay, so, something you need to understand about GTA 6 is that it is at the center of a massive online culture war. Conservative players, grifters, chuds, and other weirdos are currently spreading false information about this game online. There are also plenty of people online posting inflammatory nonsense to get clicks and engagement on sites like Twitter that reward that shit. So if you read something kind of wild about this game, just know it might be false. Check places like Kotaku or other major gaming sites to verify. Well, actually, Rockstar did remove sex workers you can pay to have sex with from GTA 6 . But there are still strippers in the game. Yes, GTA V has GTA Online , a very popular, successful, and still-ongoing multiplayer game with millions of players. This time around

sources.title: GTA 6 players are already starting to get very good at heists, despite all the new challenges Rockstar has added to the game
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 has been out for a little while now, and already players are showing off their skills when it comes to the game's many heists. Despite the challenges in getting away clean, some are proving it's possible. For one, sneaking into a bank while the vault is open and stuffing your bags full of marked bills is a tricky process of gradually making your way through rooms and taking out guards as quietly as possible. While the police in the clip below were called to an eventual breakout of violence, a lengthy getaway allowed for a cheeky payday of almost $100,000 in cash. This crew really cracked a whole bank vault and walked out with almost $100K in GTA 6 💰🏦🚔😮‍💨 #gtavi #gta pic.twitter.com/pJyFXREBvY One especially impressive element of Grand Theft Auto 6 is how many of its little mechanics interact with each other. As you can see below, if you bring a vehicle with a winch to a cash machine, you can actually pull it off the wall and drag it away from the scene of the crime. Why rob a bank in GTA 6 when you can just take the whole ATM💸 How to do it❓ - Hook the ATM up to a vehicle with a winch - Drag it through the streets until the cash cases fall out - Shoot them open and get out fast, the cops come quickly! (via u/MelloYello917) pic.twitter.com/5eXbULJWP3 As you progress through Grand Theft Auto 6, the game actually introduces you to both styles of heists. Without spoiling exactly how this happens, you're told how to go about taking on such criminal ventures, and you can continue to do so throughout the game at your pleasure. Still, even after you've been tutorialised, pulling off one of these heists is no joke, and can easily turn chaotic. This GTA 6 robbery sequence was CRAZY, I couldn't even think straight . pic.twitter.com/l65xSFRoSr Here's a little tip for those of you looking to pull off a heist yourself. You're told that safety deposit boxes can be rifled through for additional loot. However, when you actually make your way into a vault, these will be closed without much sign on which you can access. If you use the focus mode (by pushing in both L3 and R3), it will highlight boxes which you can shoot open. This, of course, may garner unwanted attention, so whether or not you think it's worth doing is part of the risk/reward dilemma you'll have to reckon with. As is the case with so much stuff in GTA 6 including, but not limited to, car-jacking . If you're looking to get your life of crime properly underway, you can read our GTA 6 robberies page for a breakdown on how it works. Alternatively, for a wider view of the game, our GTA 6 walkthrough is the way to go.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: GTA 6 recomp leaders bail out as Take-Two cracks down on illicit efforts to get the game running on PC
sources.text: The leads of Leonida, the biggest and best-known effort to recreate GTA 6 on PC, have quit the project, although others are still trying to carry it on. Just a day after Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker Cyberleek released the executable for the near-complete Xbox build of the game they dropped on Friday, at least two of the leads of Leonida, the biggest and best-known effort to recompile it to run on PC, have called it quits—seemingly under pressure from Take-Two and Rockstar. The release of the exe made the pirated Xbox build effectively complete, and that opened the door for recomp projects to do their thing—that is, to leverage AI to quickly whip up a version of the game that will run on PC. Some hackers estimated it could be done within a week; Shayder, one of the lead developers on the Leonida project, said on X that followers could "expect a lot of static recompilation work to be done soon." In a separate message on the Leonida Discord, Shayder tempered expectations a bit, writing that "it will take at least a week" to come up with something playable on PC. During a subsequent livestream, however, the team was seemingly able to get the GTA 6 splash screen to come up on PC, although it crashed after that. It sure seemed like things were moving ahead quickly. But then things began moving quickly in a different direction. "I quit guys. I’m sorry," NotRexed, apparently the head of the project, posted last night on X . "I really want to make cool stuff but every single time shit happens that I can’t control so I’m stepping away. Thank you everybody, especially in the discord that allowed me to have this opportunity." Later, they added , "Last post from me. I wanna clear things up. Rockstar taking my server down was only part of the reason. Like I’ve said before, I’m a 15 year old kid. Managing school and sports is hard enough without having middle aged men yell and complain to you on Discord. Goodbye." In a reply post, NotRexed stated explicitly that "Rockstar shut the server down," and shared an image of the copyright violation notice he'd received from Discord. Shayder, who had previously predicted rapid progress on the Leonida effort following the release of the Xbox executable, took a more direct approach and simply deleted all of their X posts. Keep up to date with the most important stories and the best deals, as picked by the PC Gamer team. This isn't necessarily the end of work to bring GTA 6 (in a probably not-great state) to PC via AI. Other such projects are underway, and there also appears to be an effort to carry on with Leonida: The website remains up, with a new name attached as owner, and there's at least one Discord server dedicated to it, although it appears a little less focused at this point than the original Leonida server. A new Github repository (NotRexed also deleted that) has been set up: It's "a continuation of NotRexed's Leonida project," according to a note on the project, which adds that "development continues here with its full commit history." The advent of AI greatly simplifies and speeds up the work of bringing console games to PC (as long as you're not too picky about the quality), and that makes life tougher for companies that want to keep a lid on such projects. Still, it's not surprising that Take-Two and Rockstar are going hard on it: In the past, Take-Two has moved aggressively to shut down GTA 5 mod projects, an effort that culminated in its acquisition of the biggest and best of them . I've reached out to Take-Two for more information on the takedown and will update if I receive a reply. From there he graduated to the glory days of Sierra Online adventures and Microprose sims, ran a local BBS, learned how to build PCs, and developed a longstanding love of RPGs, immersive sims, and shooters. He began writing videogame news in 2007 for The Escapist and somehow managed to avoid getting fired until 2014, when he joined the storied ranks of PC Gamer. He covers all aspects of the industry, from new game announcements and patch notes to legal disputes, Twitch beefs, esports, and Henry Cavill. Lots of Henry Cavill. sources.title: GTA 6 recompilers and vibe-coders implore AI chatbots to 'work faster' and 'make no mistakes' as they race to get the game running on PC
sources.text: Things continue to get messy in the community of players working on getting Grand Theft Auto 6 working on PC. The previous frontrunner, Project Leonida, got their Discord server and GitHub repository taken down by Rockstar , but others have seemingly stepped in to finish the job. The most up-to-date build of GTA 6 was allegedly leaked earlier this week by notorious leaker CyberLeek . This is a supposedly near-final build of the game's Xbox version, and it's seemingly being used as the basis for the recent work to port the game to PC. Unsurprisingly, most of these communities of modders rely almost exclusively on generative-AI tools like Claude and Antigravity to decompile and recompile the console version of GTA 6. That has always been the case, but the CyberLeek build only invited even more to ask AI chatbots to make the PC port for them. X user chasm has been following developments in the GTA 6 decompile and recompile communities, and recently shared some of the prompts the so-called vibe-coders are using - a few of whom livestreamed the process. "Make no mistakes," one modder prompted the AI chatbot. "Keep finding more stuff and working and pushing," another eloquently asked . "Work faster," asked another . "There has to be a faster way to iterate than this," they continued. Rockstar, which successfully managed to DMCA take down Project Leonida - including all of its 3,006 forks on lead author NotRexed's GitHub - is seemingly also going after people online discussing the community's progress. The X user in question later revealed they may no longer be able to share these updates, as their posts have also been removed "in response to a report by the copyright owner" . As for how far some of the remaining communities have managed to get, this video allegedly shows the game running on PC . This goes beyond the boot-up screen, which modders were able to reach within hours of CyberLeek's build alleged leaking . The footage runs at sub-5fps, but the visuals look to have rendered normally. Assuming Rockstar doesn't also shut down the modders who remain active, we may see another progress update. If you're already playing Rockstar's latest on consoles, the Eurogamer GTA 6 walkthrough offers comprehensive guides on relationship mechanics , how the new Criminal Profile system works , a list of all safe codes and more.

sources.name: Polygon
sources.title: GTA 6 Players Are Running Into a Game-Breaking Bug
sources.text: Grand Theft Auto 6 ’s Leonida is full of dangers: murderous wildlife, over-eager cops, unhinged backwoods drug dealers, terrible drivers, and much more. However, all these threats pale in comparison to a particularly deadly foe. GTA 6 has a game-breaking soft lock bug that makes it impossible to progress. The X user @SirGrotti posted a clip of the glitch, showing how they can no longer switch from Lucia to Jason, with the option permanently grayed out. The glitch can occur in Chapter 3 after the Missing Persons mission, and it’s game-breaking because the next story segment requires Jason. Comments on the post suggest several solutions, including leaving their house and then switching characters, saving and reloading, asking to meet up with Jason, sleeping, and more, but apparently, none of these worked for SirGrotti. Unfortunately, SirGrotti isn't alone. The website GTA6Bugs tracks user-reported cases of crashes, softlocks, and other problems. Of the dozens of bugs logged on the site, the Chapter 3 softlock has the most views. While there are a few fixes that worked for some players, not everyone has been so lucky. The first fix is to load a manual save from before you drove to the warehouse in Port Gellhorn for the final Missing Persons meeting. Then switch to Jason and play through the Dealer’s Choice mission until you can switch to Lucia freely. Make a manual save in a new slot and finish Missing Persons. Beyond this fix, other potential workarounds include playing another Lucia or duo mission if one is available, calling Dunk from Lucia’s phone, and robbing a store as a pair before starting Raul’s job as Lucia. GTA 6 ’s 01.002.002 update didn’t seem to fix this problem, but c onsidering this seems to be one of the most reported game-breaking issues, ideally Rockstar will address it soon. Beyond these softlocks, another common issue for GTA 6 players is a mysterious PS5 crash , which both Rockstar and Sony customer support have blamed on the other party. Things can always be much worse, though: some GTA 6 players have uploaded videos of the game’s demanding graphics seemingly frying their PS5s. One clip from shivjam shows the console dying in real time, while another has a streamer's PlayStation billowing smoke . Console and controller technician Modyfikator89 described GTA 6 as " the toughest real-world PS5 stress test " he had ever seen. With the ongoing chip crisis driving game console prices higher than ever, it's a particularly bad time to be left high and dry.

sources.title: All GTA 6 Kitty Litter lab locations
sources.text: Take Out Kitty Litter for Tyrone across the Vice City. Taking Out Kitty Litter's lab locations in GTA 6 is a mission in Tyrone's questline, and sees you searching the city for 18 secret labs (after the first one he directs you to). Every lab has a red smoking chimney and a blue and white Spin On This laundry van parked outside. It'll take a little while, but it's well worth it to get the unique gold SMG at the end. Plus, Tyrone will start buying narcotics from you for the highest price possible. To destroy each lab, simply shoot a smoking pink flask and then run away. I've also laid these out in the most optimal order , separated into regions, so you're not driving back and forth across Vice City. Last note: if you want to unlock map markers for the labs yourself versus relying on these videos, you can threaten cooks in certain labs to potentially reveal them, or talk to Tyrone when you're fencing goods. After you complete some missions for Tyrone (when you meet him with Dre'Quan during Dealer's Choice ) he'll direct you to this trailer park in La Perle where you destroy the first Kitty Litter lab and start the hunt for the others. You can see the route to the lab in the video above. You can find this one in the trailer park opposite Zenon's Pawn Shop Ammu-Nation in La Perle. As soon as you go through the main gate, you can see the trailer with the funnel chimney where they're cooking straight ahead. Sneak around the back and break inside to find the lab. Or take out the three guys in front and go in that way. Just across the road from the Mezzasega Espresso and Slinger in the Decor District. Pull off to the right of the road into the Williams + Whitaker Homeware and Decor car park. You'll see a garage with a shutter at the far end with a smoking chimney and the laundry van parked. Open the shutter to find a lone guy in the lab. This one is behind Peterson's Autoshop in Rockridge, directly south across the road from the Blessed Food Market, under the overpass, on the border between Rockridge and La Perle. Head through the main yard and turn left to spot the laundry van. Break into it, move it forward, and open the shutter behind to find the lab. Just east of Fleeca Field stadium, next door to Xero Gas - Rockridge. You'll spot the blue and white laundry van parked off to the side of the road behind a wall. Head down that alley and turn right to find a garage door you can open with the lab inside. On the east side of the condominium building directly south of the Vice City Hospital, by Emilio's Auto Center Gas. Look for the closed road with the laundry van parked at the southern end and some staircases and flats off to the side with the chimney spewing smoke. The lab is through the white door on the bottom floor. Just down the road to the west of Bump and Grind coffee and Salon Belle, in a block of flats southeast of Fleeca Fields stadium. You can see the laundry van parked outside. The lab is on the upper floor on the left side in apartment 5, where you can see the smoking chimney. Break in via the front door to find the lab. This lab is an easy one to find, around the back of Cross My Heart Tattoos. Head around the right side, turn left, and look to your left for the garage door with the guy sitting down guarding it, with the lab inside. This lab is in the block of flats to the southeast of the Jack of Hearts and Urban Legendz, with the laundry van parked out front. Look inside apartment 103 on the first floor on the left side. It's quite hard to get away from this lab blowing up, so shoot it from outside and run away. Also this will likely cause a big shootout in the block, so book it. This lab is to the southwest of your apartment in Chapter 3 and to the east of the Crosstown Mule - City Line marker. Look for an overgrown lot with the laundry van parked in it. The garage with the lab is just behind that. This lab is directly west of Down Town Pawn, just between Rideout Customs and the Vargo's Gas station. Just past the gas station, look to the left where its fuel sign is to spot a laundry van, and further down the track, the garage with the lab and smoking chimney above it. This lab is close to Xero Gas - Tequesta and west of Vice Seven Condominiums gym. When driving east to west past the station, turn right and keep an eye on your right towards the two floored condominiums for the laundry van parked outside. You want the set of staircases to the right of the van. Take the right side one up to the first floor to find the lab door directly ahead. This lab is in a trailer park directly east down the road from Arrow Gas - VCIA, also west under the bridge from Pawn City and Vice City Firearms. Turn into the trailer park, take the first right and drive a little way around the corner to spot the trailer with the smoking chimney on the left. You can enter via a window around the other side to find the lab. This lab is located in the far south of Salton, north of the Pay 'N' Spray - Salton, next door to the Slator Towing Inc robbery. Go around the south side of the derelict block of flats and climb the dumpster to jump up through the open window to find the lab. This lab is west down the road from Xero Gas - Salton. Cross the train tracks, then keep an eye on your right for a carpark with a blue and white laundry van, then turn right into it to spot the building with the smoking chimney on the right. Hop the fence straight ahead and turn right to find one guy guarding the garage with the lab. This lab is easy to find, directly south of Salon Perez and Safia Restaurant in Little Cuba. Look for some bungalows on the left with the laundry van parked outside. It's in the building with the chimney to the left of the one the van is parked in front of. The lab is the second door along. This lab is north up the road from the Pay 'N' Spray - Balsero. Turn left down the alley with the laundry van parked to find a guy guarding the gate, a couple of guys inside, and the lab in an open garage further back

sources.title: How to Win Drone Races in GTA 6—All Locations & Tips to Win
sources.text: Struggling to win Drone Races in GTA 6? We’ve got your back. Not only does this side activity reward you with a solid payout for every circuit you finish, but it’s also a mandatory step on your road to the platinum trophy . Because the strict time limits make these courses notoriously tough to beat, we’ve put together this guide with essential tips to make your runs much easier. Below, you’ll also find images showing all 14 Drone Race locations in GTA 6 so you can track down every single one without wasting time. You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already! Before you start pursuing the Drone Races locations, have in mind that competing at each Drone Race location requires a $250 entry fee, meaning you’ll need at least $3,500 in total to access all 14 spots . Fortunately, the payouts easily cover the cost. Each location features three courses, and beating the target time earns you a solid cash prize: $750 for the first course, $1,500 for the second, and $3,000 for the third. The very first thing you should do before attempting any Drone Races in GTA 6 is lower your horizontal and vertical sensitivity to 4 or below . I personally use 3, as it gives you much more stability and precision while controlling the drone. Many of these courses are packed with tight obstacles like pipes, scaffolding, and narrow gaps, so steady handling is essential. To adjust this, go to Options → Settings → Controller and turn down both Horizontal Look Sensitivity and Vertical Look Sensitivity. How you handle the controller also makes a huge difference during these races. Keep the left stick pushed strictly forward (up) to maintain momentum—avoid tilting it left or right, as that will immediately make the drone unstable. Instead, use the right stick exclusively to steer left and right through the checkpoints. Understanding how checkpoints work will also make your runs much easier. You don’t need to fly directly through the center of each ring —simply flying close to the edge is enough for it to register. Use this generous hitbox to your advantage to dodge obstacles and maintain your momentum instead of losing speed on sharp, abrupt turns. If you clip an obstacle, don’t panic—instead, treat your crashes as either major or minor mistakes. In most races, you have enough margin for error to recover from one major mistake (costing 2–3 seconds) and one minor mistake (costing 1–2 seconds). However, if a crash sets you back more than 3 seconds, immediately restart the course by holding the Square button (or X on Xbox) so you don’t waste time on a dead run. Experimenting with different camera perspectives can also help you. Drone Races in GTA 6 allow you to switch to a first-person view, which some players actually find easier to control . Personally, I had a harder time in first-person because it restricts your peripheral vision, making it much easier to clip obstacles on either side. Still, it’s worth testing out to see which view feels most comfortable for you. Finally—and perhaps most importantly—each Drone Race location features three separate courses, with only the first unlocked right away (the other two will display a lock icon). To progress, you must beat the target time on both the first and second races. However, for the third and final race at each spot, you don’t actually need to beat the clock for it to count toward the trophy—you just need to cross the finish line . This is a massive relief, as the courses scale progressively in difficulty, essentially acting as Easy, Normal, and Hard tiers. To unlock the Platinum trophy, you’ll need to complete all 42 Drone Races in GTA 6. One extra tip to save you a ton of time when tracking down these Drone Race locations in GTA 6: Use the RydeMe app on your phone to fast travel. It lets you jump straight from one race spot to the next without having to drive across the entire map. That covers all 14 Drone Race locations in GTA 6 ! If you need help with anything else in the game, be sure to stop by our full GTA 6 guides hub —it’s packed with everything you need to know about the biggest game release of all time. Are you enjoying the Drone Races in GTA 6? Leave your thoughts down in the comments, and join the official Insider Gaming Discord server . sources.title: All Peewees Billboard locations in GTA 6
sources.text: How to claim the Peewees Billboard grand prize How to claim the Peewees Billboard grand prize Peewees Billboards are one of the many scannable WAiNK collectibles in Grand Theft Auto 6 , but they're also part of the Mr. Enigma X Peewees scavenger hunt. Mr. Enigma, a play on Dr. Pepper, and the Peewees, a play on Popeyes, have teamed up to create a challenge where you must find four Peewees billboards, and you'll earn a valuable reward. All the info you're given is that there is a billboard in the following areas: Vice-Dale, Mariana County, Lummox County, and Leonard County. As these areas are fairly large, it can take a long time to find them. To save you some time, we've listed where you can find every Peewees Billboard in GTA 6 below. To start the Mr. Enigma X Peewees scavenger hunt, look out for a Peewees post on Snapmatic, or you can look for one of the four Peewees billboards. After you start, you'll get a text from Chicken Challenge, telling you that you've entered the scavenger hunt. They'll also send you a clue that points you toward another billboard when you start the challenge and every time you find one. There are four Peewees Billboards in GTA 6 , with one in Vice-Dale, Mariana County, Lummox County, and Leonard County. To mark them off the list, head to their location and scan them using WAiNK (hold Up on your D-pad). Below, we explain where you can find each billboard in detail. The Vice-Dale Peewees Billboard is on the west side of Balsero , which is the northwest corner of Vice-Dale County . The billboard itself is between Route US-10 and US-35 , which is just northwest of Randy's shop . The Mariana County Peewees Billboard is technically in Big Pine in Grassrivers , but it's very close to the border between Grassrivers and North Mariana County . Along the border, you'll find three dome-shaped buildings and Route US-82 . Head northeast of the dome-shaped buildings , and look in the median strip to find this Peewee Billboard. The Lummox County Peewees Billboard is located on the border between South West Lummox County and Mount Kalaga National Park . The billboard is just west of Route US-628 . Head north from the junction that connects US-628 to SR-73 , and you'll find the billboard on your left. The Leonard County Peewees Billboard is located in the northwest corner of Waning Sands . The billboard is just next to SR-27 , which is between Lake Leonida and Mount Hailes Club . Look northeast of Lake Leonida, and you'll find the golf course. Follow along the road until you find the Peewees Billboard. After you find every Peewees Billboard, you'll receive a text from Chicken Challenge, telling you that you won... almost! You just need to solve one more puzzle, but they don't tell you what the puzzle is. If you take a look back at the clues that Chicken Challenge has been sending you, you'll notice that a couple of letters in each photo are covered by the Peewees logo. The following letters are blocked off: V - L - I - L - L - E - B - E. Now, it looks like a bunch of gibberish, but if you scramble the letters, you'll get Belville , which is the southern region of Leonard County . It just so happens that there's a Peewees in Belville. To claim your grand prize, you need to head to the Peewees in Belville, which is just east of the hospital. Alternatively, you can open your map, scroll down to the "Fast Food" section of the "Food & Drink" tab, and select the Peewees in Belville to speed up the process. Head inside and speak with the manager to claim your reward, which is a Peewees hat, a Peewees shirt, and free Peewees food! If you're just getting started in GTA 6 , we have plenty of guides to help you live the high life in Leonida. Check out our GTA 6 beginner guide to get a grasp of the basics and our tips for what to do first , recommendations for the best ways to make money fast , and an explainer for how to keep stolen weapons and cars to make the most of your free time. Our selection of GTA 6 guides includes help for things like how to steal the Phoenix in "Unwanted Attention" and whether you should defuse Mandy , too. There's a set of explainers for GTA 6 's more open-ended side activities, like how to rob the Exotic Animal Front and where to find tree effigies for the Skunk Ape mission , and we've got all the GTA 6 cheat codes . You'll have to put in some effort before you can use those, though.

sources.title: Mario Kart World 1.9.0 Adds Replays and New Course Picks
sources.text: Mario Kart World just received a new update. Version 1.9.0, released November 24, 2026, adds Replay, two Knockout Tour rallies, new course choices and many fixes. The latest Mario Kart was the launch title for the Nintendo Switch 2 in 2025. Many feel that the title hasn’t had key updates since its release. However, Nintendo released an update late on the night of November 24 that continues to drip-feed new content into the title. Mario Kart World version 1.9.0 adds a Replay function that saves your races and battles. It also adds Feather Rally and Lucky Cat Rally to the Knockout Tour, and new course options. Another major addition is online Free Roam missions, improved spectating, and a host of other bug fixes. The eight new courses being added are versions of classic tracks. For example, DK Pass 2 has players drive in the opposite direction of the iconic Mario Kart DS course. The update is free, but it doesn’t include new characters. Check out full patch notes from Nintendo below: What are your thoughts on this update coming to the Mario Kart World, and who are you hoping to see added as part of DLC when there are even larger content updates to the game? Share your thoughts on this story and others like it in our official Discord server. For more coverage on Insider Gaming, check out some of the best Amazon deals for gamers on Black Friday . Don’t forget to sign up for our weekly newsletter , too. I'm Robert DeFelice. I spent years covering pro-wrestling industry for outlets such as Fightful. After years in wrestling journalism, I’ve transitioned to video games, another passion of mine.

sources.title: PlayStation fecha parceria com CD Projekt Red para The Witcher 4
sources.text: A CD Projekt Red anunciou uma nova parceria comercial com a Sony Interactive Entertainment que envolve a campanha de marketing de The Witcher 4 e a distribuição de jogos do estúdio no ecossistema PlayStation . O anúncio foi realizado nesta terça-feira (24), durante a apresentação dos resultados financeiros do terceiro trimestre de 2026 da desenvolvedora polonesa. Segundo Piotr Nielubowicz, diretor financeiro da CD Projekt Red, os acordos foram assinados no mesmo dia e devem contribuir para os resultados comerciais e financeiros da companhia nos próximos anos. Apesar da parceria, o acordo não estabelece exclusividade para The Witcher 4. O RPG continua em desenvolvimento para PlayStation 5 , Xbox Series X|S e PC. A colaboração envolve principalmente a futura campanha publicitária do título, seguindo um modelo semelhante ao adotado pela Sony em sua parceria de marketing com a Rockstar Games para o lançamento de GTA 6. O contrato também contempla a presença de jogos da CD Projekt Red no catálogo do PlayStation Plus . Entretanto, as empresas não divulgaram quais títulos serão disponibilizados no serviço de assinatura. Os valores financeiros e demais condições comerciais do acordo também não foram revelados. De acordo com informações do Video Games Chronicle (VGC), The Witcher 4 segue com previsão de lançamento para 2028. Atualmente, quase metade da equipe de desenvolvimento da CD Projekt Red está dedicada ao projeto. O RPG marcará o início de uma nova trilogia da franquia. Segundo os planos apresentados anteriormente pelo estúdio, a intenção é lançar os três jogos dentro de um intervalo de seis anos. A estratégia representa uma aposta da desenvolvedora na continuidade da franquia e na redução do intervalo entre seus grandes lançamentos. Por enquanto, The Witcher 4 ainda não possui uma data oficial de estreia. Rachele Victoria é formada em Letras, MBA em Inovação e atua há 10 anos com comunicação e conteúdo gamer. sources.title: Diablo IV: nova temporada chega em dezembro com mudanças no endgame; veja novidades
sources.text: A Blizzard anunciou que a Temporada do Gambito de Tyrael , de Diablo IV , chega em 1º de dezembro de 2026. A atualização tem como principal objetivo oferecer aos jogadores mais liberdade para personalizar suas experiências no endgame, etapa posterior à campanha principal. Entre as novidades estão mudanças nos Planos de Guerra, uma nova árvore de progressão sazonal, equipamentos inéditos e novos confrontos contra chefes. A temporada também apresenta uma série de missões protagonizadas por Tyrael, que investiga as verdadeiras intenções do culto da morte e uma nova ameaça a Santuário. A Temporada do Gambito de Tyrael introduz seis principais novidades: Além dos conteúdos inéditos, a Blizzard confirmou que recursos populares da Temporada do Legado Infernal serão incorporados permanentemente aos reinos de Temporada e Eternos. Com as mudanças, a Blizzard busca ampliar a variedade de atividades disponíveis no endgame e oferecer mais autonomia para que os jogadores desenvolvam seus personagens de acordo com seus objetivos. A Temporada do Gambito de Tyrael estará disponível a partir de 1º de dezembro. Rachele Victoria é formada em Letras, MBA em Inovação e atua há 10 anos com comunicação e conteúdo gamer.
